# pve_api_token (Resource)

API token of a user. The full token value is captured into token_value (sensitive) at creation and whenever regenerate = true invalidates and reissues the secret — PVE returns it exactly once and it can never be read back afterward.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_api_token" "example" {
  tokenid = "CHANGE_ME"
  userid  = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tokenid` (String) User-specific token identifier.
- `userid` (String) Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) <string>
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `expire` (Number) API token expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date. (default: same as user)
- `privsep` (Boolean) Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default), or give full privileges of corresponding user. (default: 1)
- `regenerate` (Boolean) Regenerate the token's secret value. All users of the previous secret will lose access after this operation. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: userid/tokenid (also the `terraform import` format).
- `token_value` (String, Sensitive)
